notices: Clinician decision C1 (2026-07-27) approved combination support with an architectural condition: combinations use this separate path, and the single-ingredient IN/PIN model in ingredient-mapping-overrides.json is unchanged. A MIN term type is admissible only here, only on identity_kind fixed_dose_combination, and only alongside a verified component list.

No combination may be recorded until the schema, validator, positive and negative tests and provenance requirements are independently approved. warfarin__cotrimoxazole is clinically approved in principle but remains blocked from promotion pending that approval.
Matching either component of a combination on its own is prohibited. A combination is matched at product level against the whole active-ingredient set.
